title: runtime.initialize
description: PRD 20.2. The first exchange on the framed transport. 24.5 forbids overclaiming a sandbox, so every capability in the result is a literal fact about the host rather than an aspirational default; crates/cbc-protocol/src/handshake.rs and packages/protocol-ts/src/client.ts both mirror this.

clientCapabilities.description: What the control plane is prepared to handle. Absent fields default to false, so an older client never appears to support something it does not.

interactionMode.description: Initial runtime enforcement mode. Plan is read-only and only accepted after startup recovery is quiescent.

enhancedSandbox.description: R-06: true only when an OS-level confinement beyond the path guard is actually active.

keychain.description: 9.3 storage backend. 'session-only' and 'encrypted-file' are weaker promises than 'os-native' and must be reported as such.

sandboxLevel.description: 14.4 enforcement level actually achieved on this host.

sandboxBackends.description: Named mechanisms in use, e.g. landlock, seccomp, seatbelt. Empty means the path guard alone.

workspace.description: Absolute path. The runtime canonicalizes it independently (14.2); the client's spelling is a request, not a fact.

dataDir.description: Overrides the durable data directory. Used by CAPYBARA_DATA_DIR and by tests (21.1).

sandboxLevel.description: Requested sandbox level from configuration (sandbox.level). The runtime clamps it to what the host can actually enforce (RT-006) and reports only the effective level in its capabilities (24.5); enforcement lives in the runtime, never the control plane (P0-04).

networkForShell.description: sandbox.networkForShell. 'deny' forces network isolation on raw shells; 'ask' and 'allow' leave the per-call decision to the approval flow.

capabilityIssuerToken.description: Secret control-plane token required for runtime capability issuance.
